question.text: How many FATF-Style Regional Bodies (FSRBs) exist globally?

explanation.text: The Logic: Nine FATF-Style Regional Bodies (FSRBs) have been established: APG, CFATF, EAG, ESAAMLG, GABAC, GAFILAT, GIABA, MENAFATF, and MONEYVAL. Together with FATF, they constitute a global network to combat ML/TF/PF. The Trap: Nine is the specific number — not to be confused with the number of FATF Recommendations (40) or FATF members (40). The FSRBs are also called 'FATF Associate Member organisations.' Cross-Exam Context: FSRBs conduct mutual evaluations in their regions. For IFSCA-01, the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) is most relevant as it covers India's region. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Nine FSRBs: APG (Asia-Pacific), CFATF (Caribbean), EAG (Eurasia), ESAAMLG (Eastern/Southern Africa), GABAC (Central Africa), GAFILAT (Latin America), GIABA (West Africa), MENAFATF (Middle East/North Africa), MONEYVAL (Europe).
